name: Southern Star Evergy McNew Power Plant Delivery Project (Line RE)

values.StartLocation: Hugoton Loop Line RA, Reno County
values.EndLocation: Evergy meter station at McNew Power Plant, Reno County
values.Owner: Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc
values.DataCenterNotes: The pipeline serves the McNew Power Plant, a new gas-fired plant for Evergy in Reno County, Kansas. The FERC notice names the plant but does not mention data centers. The tie comes from Evergy's Missouri commission filings for the McNew and Viola plants. A post-hearing brief says demand for electricity is rising from data centers among other things, and that McNew meets the need for current known large loads, not other large loads in the pipeline. Another party's brief paraphrases Evergy as citing new data centers as a reason for need. The tie is general and no named campus is given, so it is medium at best.

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The nearest rows on this system are Viola Project (P8257, a different line), Cedar Vale Compressor Station Project (P7826) and the older expansions. A Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) scoping notice from October 2026 for docket CP26-572-000 says Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline proposes 1.6 miles of new 30-inch pipe (Line RE) from a new Hutchinson Compressor Station on its Hugoton Loop Line RA to a new meter station at the McNew Power Plant in Reno County, Kansas. It also adds a compressor station and changes two existing ones in Harvey and Stafford counties. The FERC pending projects page lists the filing as August 31, 2026, with 5,700 horsepower; I used it only for the filing year. The notice states a capacity of 710 megawatts per day, which is an odd unit, so capacity is left blank. It is a new row because it has new pipe, under the parent system name as the roster spells it. Data center tie: only through the plant, from Evergy's Missouri filings (documents 837383 and 837396), where data centers are named among demand drivers and large loads are named for McNew. This is general, not a named campus, so the tag is medium confidence and a reviewer could drop it. Route not found, so no route. Owner spelling follows the ownership team's existing entity 'Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline Inc'. The FERC notice is the only source that names the pipeline.
